events.description: Individuals in dark clothing and masks collectively push, topple, and throw metal crowd-control barriers; one person lifts and hurls a trash bin at the fallen barriers.

verification.reason: The coordinated destruction of public infrastructure (barriers) by a group, with visible force and intent to disrupt order, satisfies the definition of riot as collective violent unrest—not merely a crowd or isolated acts. Frames f3–f12 show progression from barrier manipulation to full collapse and projectile use, confirming sustained collective action.
